units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 85a:3">B. Bath. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>כֶּלְיוֹ של אדם וכ׳</he> a man’s vessel takes possession for him (of its contents).
<cite ref="Berakhot 23a:19">Ber. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ שהוא כֶלְיָין</he> a receptacle which is intended for them (the T’fillin).
<cite ref="Berakhot 23a">Ib.</cite> <he>כ׳ בתוך כ׳</he> one wrapper within the other.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:59">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵈ</cite> top <he>הגודל כְּלִי צורה</he> he who shapes an earthen vessel; <he>הנופח כ׳ זכוכית</he> who shapes a glass vessel by blowing; <he>העושה כ׳ בדפוס</he> who makes a vessel in a mould.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:2:1">Y. Ḥag. III, 79ᵃ</cite> top, a. fr. <he>נזקקו לכֶילְיָין</he> they are tied to their vessel, i.e. the vessel in which they are offered makes them to be considered one mass, though they are otherwise disconnected; <cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 3:2">Ḥag. III, 2</cite> <he>הכ׳ מצרף וכ׳</he>. Mekh. Yithro, Amalek, 2 (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 18:19">Ex. XVIII, 19</cite>) <he>היה להם ככ׳ מלא דברות</he> be unto them like a vessel filled with divine revelations.

<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 2:1">Ab. d’R. N., II</cite> vers., ch. II, v. <cite ref="J00268"><he>יָחַד</he></cite>. Mekh. Bo., beg. <he>כלל לדברות</he>; Tanḥ. Bo. 5 <he>כלול לד׳</he> (read <cite ref="K00715"><he>כלי</he></cite>) a vessel of revelation; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כֵּלִים</he>, constr. <cite ref="K00716"><he>כְּלֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 3:1">Ḥag. III, 1</cite> <he>כ׳ בתוך כ׳</he> vessels put into larger vessels.

senses.gloss: outfit, apparel, garment, tool, weapon. Pl. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 114a:3">Sabb. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ לבנים</he> white garments; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Genesis 41:44">Gen. XLI, 44</cite>) <he>כ׳ ידים</he> official badge of the hands (bracelets, rings &c.), <he>כ׳ רגלים</he> greaves &c.; (Ar. a. Rashi <cite ref="K00724"><he>כלידרים</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00724"><he>כלידרין</he></cite>, corrupt. of <he>כלי ידים</he>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 89:7">Gen. R. s. 89</cite> <he>שאין עבד … כ׳ ידים</he> (some ed. <cite ref="K00724"><he>כלידים</he></cite>, Ar. <cite ref="K00724"><he>כלידרין</he></cite>; Yalk. ib. 147 <cite ref="K00697"><he>כלודי</he></cite>, corr. acc.) that no servant was to hold office or wear rings &c. (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Annulus).—<he>כלי זיין</he>, v. <cite ref="G00337"><he>זַיִין</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:13">B. Mets. IX, 13</cite> <he>חייב משום שני כ׳</he> he is guilty of having seized two implements (the upper and the lower millstone).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:13">Ib.</cite> <he>שני כ׳</he> two objects of use (a mattress and a plough).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:2">B. Bath. V, 2</cite> <he>כֵּלָיו</he> the outfit of the ass (saddle &c.); a. fr.
